verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of blocking tracking pixels, proxying remote images, or any default protection against sender read-tracking. It also has no first-party disclosure explaining how Gmail uses mail data. The community items about opting into Smart Features and leaving Gmail to avoid snooping are user sentiment, not documented capabilities, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a switcher, the client protects me from senders' tracking — blocking read pixels by default — and is transparent about what it does with my mail data
